lines.text: The righteousness of God has been revealed apart from the law, and it comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe.
All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, and are justified freely by His grace.
God presented Jesus as an atoning sacrifice in His blood through faith, to demonstrate His mercy.
Boasting is excluded on the principle of faith, for a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law.
Because there are two gods, He will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
